summary: Immix Biopharma, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on September 30, 2026, reporting an underwriting agreement dated September 29, 2026, with J.P. Morgan Securities LLC for an underwritten public offering of 11,363,637 common shares at $11.00 per share, grossing roughly $125.0 million and netting about $117.1 million after discounts, commissions, and expenses. The offering was made under a January 2026 shelf registration statement declared effective January 22, 2026, with a September 29, 2026 prospectus supplement. Closing was expected September 30, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation.
